name: File System
description: Read, write, patch, search, discover, attach and share local files, documents and images.
progressive_guidance: Use file for reading local text, documents and images, writing or patching text, and attaching completed files. Use ripgrep for file discovery and content search; prepare document text with file.prepareDocumentSearch before searching extracted content. Read occupied destinations; patch updates without changing unrelated content. A requested output path does not authorize discarding its contents: save an exact, unique recoverable copy before full replacement, including shell writes. Resolve ordinary collisions without owner confirmation. Verify the new output and preserved bytes before completion; retain and briefly report the saved copy. If evidence is missing, verify or recover with tools. Keep shared files on Leon’s host. Use miniserve for read-only LAN browser links and magic_wormhole for encrypted live internet transfers. Both require the host to remain running; shares expire or can be stopped. These tools do not upload files into third-party cloud storage.
